teaser.en: Crush a leaf and it smells of citrus: Digo call it the little wild lime of the forest.
teaser.sw: Ponda jani lake na litanukia kama limau: Wadigo huuita mdimu mdogo wa porini wa msituni.

summary.en: *Chidimu tsaka* is an aromatic forest shrub of the citrus family. Digo see it as a small, wild, forest form of the lime tree.
summary.sw: *Chidimu tsaka* ni kichaka chenye harufu nzuri cha msituni, cha familia ya michungwa. Wadigo hukiona kuwa umbo dogo la porini la msituni la mdimu.

about.en: *Toddaliopsis sansibarensis* is a shrub or small tree of the citrus family. Its leaves are divided into three leaflets dotted with tiny oil glands, and they give off a citrus-like scent when crushed. It bears small flowers and small fruits. Digo identify it by its leaves and its smell.
about.sw: *Toddaliopsis sansibarensis* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya michungwa. Majani yake yamegawanyika kuwa vijani vitatu vyenye vitone vidogo vya tezi za mafuta, na hutoa harufu kama ya limau yanapopondwa. Huzaa maua madogo na matunda madogo. Wadigo hukitambua kwa majani yake na harufu yake.

where.en: It grows in the coastal forests of Kenya and Tanzania, including Zanzibar.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania, ikiwemo Zanzibar.

names.en: *Chidimu tsaka* means 'small lime plant of the forest'. It is named after *mdimu*, the lime tree, but grows wild in the forest (*tsaka*), and Pakia notes it has smaller fruits, hence the diminutive *chi-*. It is also smaller than the plants Digo call *mdimu tsaka*, 'forest lime'. Giriama shares the name.
names.sw: *Chidimu tsaka* maana yake ni 'mdimu mdogo wa msituni'. Kimepewa jina la *mdimu*, mti wa ndimu, lakini huota porini msituni (*tsaka*), na Pakia anaeleza kwamba kina matunda madogo zaidi, ndiyo maana kina kiambishi cha udogo *chi-*. Pia ni kidogo kuliko mimea ambayo Wadigo huiita *mdimu tsaka*, 'mdimu wa msituni'. Kigiriama kinashiriki jina hili.

reason.en: Lime, the tree it is named after
reason.sw: Mdimu, mti ambao kimepewa jina lake

reason.en: Toddalia, a climber of the citrus family
reason.sw: Toddalia, mtambaaji wa familia ya michungwa

reason.en: Vepris, a forest shrub of the citrus family
reason.sw: Vepris, kichaka cha msituni cha familia ya michungwa
